messages:
Lena (People Ops): Heads-up: two quick compliance items this month - mandatory phishing simulation completion + annual privacy attestation. Deadline for both: 2026-04-10 23:59 UTC. Please complete the short training and attest in the spreadsheet. Link: https://go.redwoodinference.com/compliance-apr-2026

Marco (Security): Phishing sim will send test emails between 2026-04-01 and 2026-04-07. If you click, you'll get a short remediation module and must finish it within 48h. No punitive action, just required completion.

Eve (Legal): Note: contractors who handle customer data must also complete the privacy attestation. Internal-only contractors (no access) can be marked N/A on the spreadsheet, but please confirm with your manager.

Leo (Eng): If someone is OOO on the deadline (scheduled PTO), can we get a grace window? Two devs on my team are on parental leave.

Lena (People Ops): Yes - we have a 7-day grace period for approved PTO. Please add PTO dates to the spreadsheet row and tag me.

Alex (Contractor): Quick Q: where do I attest? The spreadsheet link asks for "evidence owner" but I don't have a sheet row.

Lena (People Ops): Contractors: your manager should have a row. If not, DM me and I'll add you.

compliance-bot: Reminder created: Privacy attestation due 2026-04-10. Use /complete-attest to record.

phish-bot: Phishing simulation scheduled for 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC - 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC. Expect emails from security@redwood-inf.test (test domain).

Marco (Security): Small security note - if you see any suspicious email outside the sim window, report via the phish report button immediately. If you're uncertain, forward to security@redwoodinference.com.

Eve (Legal): For the attestation please do NOT upload customer data or unredacted contracts. If you need to reference a vendor agreement, cite the vendor name + date and attach a redacted excerpt.

Leo (Eng): Done with training module, added attestation entry (row 22). @Lena can you confirm visibility?

Lena (People Ops): Confirmed row 22 updated, thanks Leo.

Marco (Security): FYI we're running a short report after the sim to identify patterns (e.g., people who click phishing links in test emails). We won't share individual names outside security + people ops.

Alex (Contractor): Completed remediation module after a test click. Marked done in sheet.

Lena (People Ops): TL;DR checklist:
- Finish phishing simulation remediation module if you click (or confirm simulated email wasn't clicked)
- Complete privacy attestation in the spreadsheet + add any redacted evidence links if needed
- Contractors confirm manager-row or DM me
- PTO grace requests to people-ops by 2026-04-05 EOD

Lena (People Ops): Office hours for any questions: 2026-04-02 15:00 UTC in #help. I'll post a calendar invite.

Marco (Security): Any exceptional vendor/legal holds that block attestation? Tag @Eve and we'll triage.

Eve (Legal): Approved holds must include a reason, expected release date, and legal owner. Put details in the sheet under the "holds" column.

Lena (People Ops): Final reminder 48h before deadline. If you're not sure whether this applies to you, check the sheet or ping me. Thanks everyone :wave:
